directive_basis: R404 item 10: current maturity -> next experiment -> expected information gain -> evidence required -> commercial state after PASS -> commercial state after FAIL. The bridge between scientific truth and technology transfer.

chain.current_maturity: ENGINEERING_DEFINED (LX ladder): mechanism modelled, parametric CAD shipped and independently re-verified VALID (R404), one improvement mutation KILLED and preserved, zero physical validation, novelty posture CONDITIONAL from a restored Patent-Bear search
chain.next_experiment: The bench obstruction challenge (DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json): floor lumen alone vs fully-obstructed primary, vs a single-lumen control catheter, with the dominant obstruction material — including the common-cause kill channel
chain.expected_information_gain: Resolves the package's core mechanism claim (does the floor carry >= Q_min when the primary dies?) AND its declared kill condition (common-cause obstruction) in one bench-class protocol — the largest single uncertainty reduction per dollar available to this package; converts MODELLED -> PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION for the floor mechanism
chain.evidence_required: Measured floor-only flow vs the pre-registered Q_min threshold; measured common-cause outcome (does the same obstruction kill both lumens?)
chain.commercial_state_after_PASS: First PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION-class evidence; TRANSFER_STATE TECHNICAL_REVIEW -> SUPPORTED_FOR_VALIDATION becomes arguable from evidence (external technical review still required); the buyer conversation shifts from 'documented hypothesis' to 'bench-validated safety-floor mechanism'
chain.commercial_state_after_FAIL: Common-cause kill or floor flow far below any defensible Q_min -> repair pipeline first (the unexplored design space is recorded: OD envelope, intermediate floor diameters, primary/offset parameters); if repair fails, cemetery with the lesson codified (Art. LI). NOT a silent downgrade
